headline: Parcels worth up to 150 euros will no longer be exempt from VAT: what the Rada is preparing
summary: Ukraine is changing tax rules for international parcels bought through foreign marketplaces, with parcels up to 150 euros no longer exempt from VAT, according to the Rada's plans.
why: Changes to VAT on low-value cross-border parcels affect online retailers and marketplaces serving Ukrainian consumers. They also shift import costs and competitiveness.
